stories.title: The Bonnaroo tent
details: about 100 degrees
Chris's tent collapsed the first night because he pitched it on a slope
Megan walked over with a mallet and stakes and rebuilt it in ten minutes without a word; he held instructions upside down
met again at a show that night, spent the weekend together
long distance Denver-Nashville about a year, Megan moved out in 2016
married October 2019 in Asheville in pouring rain; Ben officiated, ordained online for $20
